spots.name: Mural by Isaac Weber;Rawn Razor;Brad Ladeour;Lindsey Lickers
tags: artist: Isaac Weber;Rawn Razor;Brad Ladeour;Lindsey Lickers
spots.blurb: This mural is by Isaac Weber;Rawn Razor;Brad Ladeour;Lindsey Lickers, painted in 2013. This mural depicts the natural and First Nations context of the area and promotes environmental preservation by incorporating the area's three distinct eco-systems and animals that historically thrived (but not longer live) in the area.

spots.blurb: This street art piece is by Ingrid Mayrhofer, painted in 2016. The patterns are Central European in origin, the practice of cross-stitch emroidery is known internationally.
